cues.en: So what we ended up building was basically a petri dish,
cues.zh: 我们最终做出来的东西基本上就是一个培养皿，

cues.en: except that it's two feet by four feet. And the way we set it up is that there are nine bands. And at the base of each of these bands,
cues.zh: 只不过它是两英尺乘四英尺。搭建方式是分成九个条带，每个条带的底部，

cues.en: we put a normal petri dish thick agar with different amounts of antibiotic.
cues.zh: 我们放一个普通培养皿，铺上厚琼脂，抗生素剂量各不相同。

cues.en: On the outside, there's no antibiotic.
cues.zh: 最外圈没有抗生素。

cues.en: Just in from that,
cues.zh: 往里一点，

cues.en: there's barely more than the C. Coli can survive.
cues.zh: 浓度仅略高于 C. Coli 能存活的水平。

cues.en: Inside of that, there's 10 times as much, a 100 times, and then finally, the middle band has a thousand times as much antibiotic.
cues.zh: 再往里是10倍、100倍，最后中间条带的抗生素浓度是1000倍。

cues.en: And then across the top of it, pour some thin agar that bacteria can move around in. The background is black because there's ink in it, and the bacteria appear as white.
cues.zh: 然后在顶部倒一层薄琼脂，细菌可以在其中移动。背景是黑色因为里面加了墨水，细菌显示为白色。

cues.en: First,
cues.zh: 首先，

cues.en: you see they spread in the area where there's no antibiotic up until the point they can no longer survive.
cues.zh: 你会看到它们在无抗生素区域扩散，直到无法继续存活的位置。

cues.en: Then a mutant appears on the right.
cues.zh: 然后右侧出现一个突变体。

cues.en: It's resistant to the antibiotic. It spreads
cues.zh: 它对这种抗生素有抗药性。它扩散开来，

cues.en: until it starts to compete with other mutants around it.
cues.zh: 直到开始与周围其他突变体竞争。

cues.en: When these mutants hit the next boundary,
cues.zh: 当这些突变体碰到下一个边界，

cues.en: they too have to pause and develop new mutations to make it into 10 times as much antibiotic.
cues.zh: 它们也必须停下来，发展出新的突变，才能进入抗生素浓度为10倍的区域。

cues.en: And then you see the different mutants
cues.zh: 然后你会看到不同的突变体

cues.en: repeat this at 100.
cues.zh: 在100倍处重复这一过程。

cues.en: And after about eleven days,
cues.zh: 大约十一天后，

cues.en: they finally make it into 1,000 times as much antibiotic as the wild type can survive.
cues.zh: 它们终于进入了抗生素浓度达野生型可存活浓度1000倍的区域。

cues.en: And so we can see by this process of accumulating successive mutations
cues.zh: 所以，通过这种不断累积连续突变的过程，我们可以看到

cues.en: that
cues.zh: 即

cues.en: bacteria, which are normally sensitive to an antibiotic,
cues.zh: 通常对某种抗生素敏感的细菌，

cues.en: can evolve resistance to extremely high concentrations in a short period of time.
cues.zh: 能在短时间内进化出对极高浓度抗生素的抗药性。
